name: Pick-one wheel
use_when: the group can't decide and wants Muse to just pick
'idk you pick', 'spin for it', 'random', 'flip a coin'
choosing a person at random: who drives, who goes first, turn order (noRepeat)
dont_use_when: handing out a list of chores or tasks to people (use assign)
guarantees: picks come from the server seed, the same for everyone, and show only once confirmed
spins are at least 3 s apart, so no one re-spins mid-turn
with noRepeat, each pick leaves the wheel until reset
every pick is an option on the wheel; anyone in the chat, including a late joiner, can spin or add
with fewer than two options there is no wheel: a short card asks the chat to add some, and the wheel appears at two

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Where are we eating?'

options.description: Options named in the chat, up to 10, short (places, people's names, movies). Use [] when the chat names none: never invent options; the card then asks the group to add some

noRepeat.description: true if a picked option should leave the wheel (turn order, elimination)
